current.service_desc: YARDOS US Government (YARDOS:USG) is a single, provider-operated, browser-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) and cost-estimating platform hosted exclusively in AWS GovCloud (US) for direct adoption by U.S. federal agencies (44 U.S.C. § 3506). Built for capital-intensive, long-service federal assets—including naval vessels, federal fleets, aerospace and defense depots, installations, and civil infrastructure—YARDOS:USG unifies work planning, inspection plans, condition found reports, change-order workflows, execution reporting, Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE) / growth-work IGE preparation (FAR 15.404-1, FAR 36.203, DFARS 243.204-70, GAO-20-195G), and agency-controlled specialist AI assistance in one cloud record. Each federal agency runs in a dedicated AWS GovCloud (US) account with agency identity federation, governed in-boundary AI without external model training on customer data, and role-based separation so prime and subcontractor personnel access only authorized technical scope while procurement-sensitive government estimates remain restricted to agency personnel (FAR 3.104). Commercial YARDOS and customer-hosted or on-premises installations are excluded from the FedRAMP 20x Class C scope.
